# it. Places with a grid of the game keep it; those not named are pictures.

#   <level> none                 no ground: a picture, not a place
#   <level> like <level>         the same place: the same ground
#   <level> area <x y x y ...>   traced by hand: the ground is this polygon...
#   <level> hole <x y x y ...>   ...without this one
#   <level> rock <x> <y> <r>     ...nor this round one (a rock, a tree)
#   <level> soil <r g b> <share> <least>   ...nor a tile with <share>% off that colour,
#                                in walls of <least> tiles or more
#
